original_value: Components are the significant part of a system which plays an important role in the functionality of the system. Components are the reusable part of a system which are already tested, debugged, and experienced based on the previous practices. A new system is developed based on the reusable components, as reusability of components is recommended to save time, effort, and resources as such components are already made. Security of components is a significant constituent of the system to maintain the existence of the component as well as the system to function smoothly. Component security can protect a component from illegal access and changing its contents. Considering the developments in information security, protecting the components becomes a fundamental issue. In order to tackle such issues, a comprehensive study report is needed which can help practitioners to protect their system. The current study is an endeavor to report some of the existing studies regarding component security evaluation based on multicriteria decision and machine learning algorithms in the popular searching libraries.

result.paraphrase: Components are an essential part of a system and play a key role in its functionality. They are reusable elements that have already been tested, debugged, and proven through prior practice. New systems are built from these reusable components because their reuse is recommended to save time, effort, and resources, since they already exist. Component security is a major aspect of a system, helping both the component and the system function smoothly. It can safeguard components against unauthorized access and tampering with their contents. With advances in information security, protecting components has become a fundamental concern. Addressing these issues requires a comprehensive study report that can assist practitioners in protecting their systems. This study aims to present some existing research on component security evaluation based on multicriteria decision-making and machine learning algorithms in popular search libraries.
